original: naidhano mitravargaśca paramo maila eva tu ||4||
analyzed: naidhanaḥ mitravargaḥ ca paramaḥ mailaḥ eva tu

tṛtīyam ekaviṃśam tu dvādaśam tu vipad karam
cemyam dvāviṃśam trayodaśam
pratvaram pañcamam vidyāt tayoviṃśam caturdaśam

original: sādhakaṃ tu caturviṃśaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tu yat |
analyzed: sādhakam tu caturviṃśam ṣaṣṭham pañcadaśam tu yat

original: nairdhanaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ tu ṣoḍaśaṃ saptamaṃ tathā ||8||
analyzed: nairdhanam pañcaviṃśam tu ṣoḍaśam saptamam tathā
maitre saptadaśam vidyāt ṣaḍviṃśam iti ca aṣṭamam

original: saptaviṃśa paraṃ maitraṃ navamaṣṭādaśaṃ ca yat ||9||
analyzed: saptaviṃśa param maitram navam aṣṭādaśam ca yat

original: navanacatrake varge prathamaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu varjayet |
analyzed: nava nacatrake varge prathamam tṛtīyam tu varjayet

original: pañcamaṃ saptamaṃ caiva śepaiḥ kāryāṇi kārayet || 10 ||
